name: Now Nudge
desc: Galaxy AI surface that reads context and surfaces the next useful suggestion.
desc_zh: Galaxy AI 的一个界面，读懂对话上下文并给出下一步有用建议。
solves: Useful suggestions arrive as separate notifications you learn to ignore; these read the conversation and appear where you already are.
solves_zh: 有用的建议总以独立通知出现，久而久之就被忽略了；这些建议读懂对话，并出现在你已经在的地方。
best_for: Someone texts you an address and you want the navigation card to appear without leaving the chat.
best_for_zh: 别人发来一个地址，你想不离开聊天就直接看到导航卡片时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Samsung Global Newsroom feed and Galaxy AI topic page）。 New with the Galaxy S26 series, announced 2026-02-26, and carried into the July 2026 foldables where it opens Multi Window when multitasking is predicted. It is a named capability inside Galaxy AI rather than a separate install. 首次公开日期来源：https://news.samsung.com/global/galaxy-unpacked-2026-highlights-from-galaxy-unpacked-the-beginning-of-truly-agentic-ai
